findings.title: A failed 'Add entry' save erases the text the gardener typed
findings.expected: When the save fails, the error shows and the typed entry text stays in the textarea so the user can try again
findings.actual: The error 'Injected 500' shows, but the Entry textarea is emptied (value ''), so the text is lost. addEntry() calls entryForm.reset() in its finally block, which runs on failure as well as success
